one_line: Eastern Ganga emperor who consolidated Kalinga and elevated Puri in the early 12th century.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown coastal Odia complexion, sharp nose, well-defined jaw, neatly trimmed moustache with no beard, calm intense eyes with slightly thick brows, default expression dignified and focused with a hint of compassionate warmth
appearance.hair: straight black hair pulled back into a high, tight kshatriya-style knot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow golden band; small tilaka of white and red on the forehead; no helmet, only the band and hair knot visible
appearance.costume: 12th-century Eastern Ganga royal attire: a richly woven silk dhoti in deep maroon with thin gold borders, pleated neatly and wrapped to the ankles in a warrior-friendly style; a fitted, short-sleeved golden-yellow angavastra-style upper cloth crossing diagonally over the torso like a sash and tied at the left hip, leaving the shoulders fully covered; over this, a light cream-colored cotton uttariya drape from left shoulder across chest and back, falling to mid-thigh; simple leather sandals; jewellery restricted to a broad gold necklace with small leaf-shaped pendants, two medium-thick gold bangles per wrist, and small round gold earrings; a narrow embroidered waist-belt in dark green with subtle geometric motifs securing the dhoti, suggesting readiness for campaign without heavy armor.
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved steel sword with a plain iron hilt and small disc pommel, carried in a brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings, worn at his left hip and held resting in his right hand when posed

ref_desc: Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva is a tall, medium-brown Eastern Ganga emperor with an oval face, high black hair knot bound by a gold band, maroon silk dhoti, golden-yellow sash-angavastra, cream uttariya, simple gold jewellery, and a plain curved steel sword in a brown scabbard, using maroon, gold, cream and dark green tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva: a tall, athletic Eastern Ganga emperor in his early thirties with a medium-brown coastal Odia complexion, oval face, sharp nose, defined jaw, neat moustache and dignified focused eyes. His straight black hair is pulled into a high knot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow golden band, and he bears a small white and red tilaka on his forehead. He wears a deep maroon silk dhoti with thin gold borders, pleated and wrapped to the ankles, secured by a narrow dark green embroidered waist-belt with subtle geometric motifs. His upper body is modestly covered by a fitted short-sleeved golden-yellow angavastra-style cloth crossing diagonally over the torso like a sash and tied at the left hip, over which a light cream cotton uttariya drape falls from the left shoulder across chest and back to mid-thigh. He has simple leather sandals and restrained jewellery: a broad gold necklace with leaf-shaped pendants, two medium gold bangles on each wrist, and small round gold earrings. At his left hip rests a long, slightly curved steel sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings; he holds the sheathed sword lightly in his right hand in a composed, heroic stance. Use deep maroon, golden yellow, cream, dark green and medium brown as the dominant colours, and show him front-facing with clear views of face, hair knot and band, layered garments, jewellery and sword for consistent redrawing.
